title: ELV Commissioning Engineer
description:
The ELV Commissioning Engineer is responsible for testing, commissioning, and ensuring the proper functioning of Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems such as CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, Structured Cabling, Public Address, and other security systems. The role involves system configuration, troubleshooting, and ensuring that all installed systems operate according to project specifications and client requirements.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Perform **testing and commissioning of ELV systems** including CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, PA systems, and structured cabling.
* Configure and program **DVR/NVR, access control panels, biometric devices, and network equipment**.
* Verify **system integration, connectivity, and communication** between different ELV systems.
* Conduct **site testing, troubleshooting, and fault rectification** during commissioning stages.
* Ensure systems are installed and functioning as per **project drawings and technical specifications**.
* Coordinate with **project managers, site engineers, and technicians** for smooth commissioning activities.
* Prepare **commissioning reports, checklists, and handover documentation**.
* Provide **technical support and basic training** to clients or facility teams on system usage.
* Identify and resolve technical issues during testing and final project handover.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of **CCTV systems, Access Control, Fire Alarm, Networking, and other ELV technologies**.
* Experience in **system configuration, testing, and troubleshooting**.
* Basic networking knowledge including **IP addressing, switches, and routers**.
* Ability to read and understand **technical drawings and system diagrams**.
* Good problem-solving and communication skills.

**Qualifications**

* **Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Electronics, Electrical, IT, or related field**.
* **1–4 years of experience** in ELV installation, testing, or commissioning.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with brands such as **Hikvision, Dahua, Bosch, Honeywell, or similar ELV systems**.
* Knowledge of **BMS integration and building automation systems**.
* Familiarity with **AutoCAD and technical documentation**.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Project Engineer
description:

* Coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams

* Ensure materials, manpower, and resources are effectively utilized
* Maintain project documentation and compliance with standards

* Strong knowledge of site management and coordination
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings
* Good communication and leadership skills
* Proficiency in MS Office; AutoCAD knowledge is an added advantage

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**

* Experience in handling multiple sites simultaneously
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Willingness to travel to different project locations
* Immediate joiners preferred

title: ELV/ BMS Technician
description:
Telenova Networks Pvt Ltd is looking for a skilled **ELV Technician** to install, configure, and maintain Extra Low Voltage (ELV) systems including CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, Networking, and other security systems. The technician will support project execution by ensuring proper installation, testing, and commissioning of ELV systems at client sites.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Installation and maintenance of **ELV systems** such as CCTV, Access Control, Fire Alarm, PA systems, and Structured Cabling.
* Install and configure **IP/Analog CCTV cameras, DVR/NVR systems**, and related surveillance equipment.
* Perform **cable laying, termination, and testing** for CAT6, fiber optic, and other ELV cables.
* Assist in **installation of access control systems, biometric devices, and video door phones**.
* Conduct **testing and commissioning** of ELV systems as per project requirements.
* Troubleshoot and repair faults in CCTV, networking, and other ELV systems.
* Read and follow **technical drawings, layouts, and installation plans**.
* Coordinate with engineers and project managers for site work completion.
* Ensure compliance with **safety standards and company procedures** during installation.
* Prepare service reports and maintain proper documentation of work done.

**Required Skills**

* Knowledge of **CCTV systems, networking, access control, and fire alarm systems**.
* Experience in **cable routing, termination (RJ45), and testing**.
* Basic networking knowledge including **IP addressing and router configuration**.
* Ability to troubleshoot hardware and system faults.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.

**Qualifications**

* **ITI / Diploma** in Electronics, Electrical, Networking, or related field.
* **0–3 years of experience** in ELV system installation and maintenance.
* Willingness to travel to project sites.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with brands like **Hikvision, Dahua, CP Plus**, or similar security systems.
* Knowledge of **BMS, PA systems, and structured cabling**.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Site Engineer Trainee
description:
Job Title: Site Engineer Trainee

Job Type: Full-time

Qualification: Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Information Technology (IT) or a related field.

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Site Engineer Trainee to handle electrical wiring, power cable installation, structured cabling, and network infrastructure works. The ideal candidate should have a basic understanding of electrical systems, cable routing, termination, testing, and maintenance procedures. The candidate must follow safety standards and coordinate effectively with supervisors and other technical teams to ensure quality and timely completion of site activities.

Key Responsibilities

- Install electrical wiring, conduits, trunking, and cable trays.

- Perform power cable laying, glanding, termination, and dressing.

- Install switches, sockets, lighting fixtures, distribution boards (DBs), MCBs, RCCBs, and related electrical accessories.

- Lay and route power, control, and low-voltage cables.

- Install structured cabling systems, including LAN (Cat 5e/Cat 6), telephone, CCTV, and CC-IN cables.

- Install and maintain cable panels, patch panels, I/O outlets, and network racks.

- Perform cable labelling, ferruling, and proper cable management.

- Test power and data cables using appropriate testing equipment.

- Conduct continuity, insulation resistance, and earthing tests.

- Identify, troubleshoot, and rectify electrical wiring and cabling faults.

- Carry out preventive maintenance and breakdown maintenance as required.

- Read and interpret electrical and cabling layout drawings.

- Follow company safety policies, applicable electrical standards, and site procedures.

- Use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and maintain safe working practices.

- Coordinate with supervisors and other technical teams to ensure smooth execution of work.

- Perform additional duties related to electrical and cabling works as assigned by management.

Educational Qualifications

- Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Electronics, Information Technology (IT), Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Candidates with relevant technical knowledge or practical experience in electrical and cabling works will be preferred.

Required Skills

- Basic knowledge of electrical wiring and cable installation.

- Understanding of power, control, and low-voltage cabling systems.

- Familiarity with LAN cabling, CCTV cabling, and network rack installations.

- Basic troubleshooting and fault identification skills.

- Ability to read electrical and cabling layout drawings.

- Knowledge of electrical safety practices and PPE requirements.

- Good communication skills and the ability to work as part of a team.

- Willingness to work at project sites and follow site instructions.

How to Apply

Interested candidates who meet the above qualifications are encouraged to apply with their updated resume.

Pay: ₹5,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: JUNIOR SERVICE TECNICIAN
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled and customer-focused **Junior Service Technician** to provide on-site technical support, installation, troubleshooting, maintenance, and repair services for computers, workstations, servers, networking equipment, and other IT hardware. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on troubleshooting skills, good customer communication abilities, and the flexibility to travel to customer locations as required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Visit customer locations to diagnose and resolve IT hardware and system-related issues.
* Install, configure, upgrade, maintain, and repair desktop computers, workstations, laptops, servers, and related IT equipment.
* Troubleshoot hardware failures involving motherboards, CPUs, RAM, GPUs, storage devices, power supplies, cooling systems, and peripherals.
* Perform hardware replacement, upgrades, component-level troubleshooting, and system optimization.
* Install and configure operating systems, drivers, firmware, BIOS/UEFI, and required software.
* Diagnose and resolve system performance, booting, overheating, connectivity, and compatibility issues.
* Provide technical support for printers, monitors, UPS systems, and other IT peripherals.
* Perform preventive maintenance and health checks of IT systems at customer locations.
* Handle system installation, relocation, commissioning, and decommissioning activities.
* Assist with basic network troubleshooting, including LAN connectivity, switches, routers, Wi-Fi, and structured cabling issues.
* Conduct hardware diagnostics and testing using appropriate tools and methods.
* Coordinate with internal service, helpdesk, sales, and technical teams to ensure timely resolution of customer issues.
* Maintain accurate service reports, job sheets, service tickets, and records of parts replaced or issued.
* Record and verify serial numbers and asset details of systems and components during service visits.
* Handle warranty and RMA-related service activities and coordinate defective component replacements.
* Collect faulty components and ensure proper handover to the service/RMA team as per company procedures.
* Ensure all replaced parts and service materials are properly documented and accounted for.
* Explain technical issues and solutions clearly to customers in a professional manner.
* Escalate complex or unresolved issues to senior engineers or the appropriate technical team.
* Follow company service procedures, safety guidelines, ESD precautions, and customer site policies.
* Complete assigned service calls within the agreed service timelines and maintain high customer satisfaction.
* Be available for occasional travel and emergency/on-call support based on business requirements.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Computer Hardware, IT, Electronics, or a related field preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in IT hardware service, field support, desktop support, or technical service.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of computer hardware and troubleshooting.
* Experience in assembling, upgrading, repairing, and maintaining desktop PCs and workstations.
* Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, drivers, BIOS/UEFI, and hardware diagnostics.
* Knowledge of basic networking and troubleshooting is preferred.
* Ability to diagnose hardware failures and identify defective components.
* Good understanding of storage devices, RAM, CPUs, GPUs, PSUs, and cooling systems.
* Good communication and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service calls.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations as required.
* Valid driving license and ability to travel locally is preferred.

**Preferred Experience:**

Experience in the following areas will be an added advantage:

* Custom-built PCs and high-performance workstations
* Gaming PCs and professional workstations
* Servers and server hardware
* GPU-based and AI systems
* Networking equipment and basic network troubleshooting
* CCTV and related IT infrastructure
* UPS and power-related IT equipment
* Hardware warranty and RMA processes
* Preventive maintenance contracts (AMC)
* On-site installation and commissioning

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of assigned service calls
* First-time resolution rate
* Customer satisfaction
* Reduction in repeat service calls
* Accuracy of service reports and documentation
* Proper handling and tracking of replaced components
* Compliance with service response and resolution timelines
* Quality of installation, repair, and preventive maintenance
* Effective coordination with internal teams

**Working Conditions:**

This is primarily a **field-based technical role** requiring regular travel to customer locations for installation, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and system upgrades. The engineer may be required to work outside normal business hours occasionally based on customer requirements and critical service situations.

**Ideal Candidate:**The ideal candidate should be a **hands-on IT hardware professional** who enjoys troubleshooting and solving technical problems at customer locations. The candidate must be technically competent, customer-friendly, disciplined in service documentation, and capable of working under time constraints while maintaining high-quality service standards.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
